note: Stage 4: rows and columns with a chocolate grid. Three rows of four counted across, then counted down the columns, then the plate turns a quarter turn and the same twelve chocolates read as four rows of three. Quiz: pick the sentence for a grid / drag chocolate strips to build a grid / listen and pick the matching grid.

lines.text: Let's look at this chocolate. Three rows and four columns.
Four, eight, twelve. Three rows of four.
Three, six, nine, twelve. Four columns of three.
Three times four is twelve. Four times three is also twelve!
Build the grid. Drag the chocolate rows.
